claim_being_audited: The actor’s claim is that certifying the model for launch is compliant and evidentially supportable on a narrow aggregate-readiness basis despite the tax filing assistant segment missing target.
decision_criteria: Use the stated policy threshold: a weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
If the limitation is material, launch requires either resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
General aggregate readiness evidence cannot override a specific unmet policy condition.
Pending legal review preserves the materiality concern rather than resolving it.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance covering the tax filing assistant gap before launch.
Final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
Final model card or launch disclosure artifact explicitly disclosing the limitation.
Evidence that the tax filing assistant is no longer a named launch use case or no longer part of the partner commitments.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the underperforming tax filing assistant is a named launch use case tied to two partner commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The release policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch for material limitations in named launch use cases, and neither is in evidence.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, which the policy text says prevents product labeling from resolving materiality.
Aggregate pass margin and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents speak to general readiness, not to satisfaction of the specific disclosure-or-acceptance requirement.
Public model-card and risk-management guidance are general governance principles and do not substitute for the required internal policy predicates.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the present record.
That remaining risk can be managed through model-card disclosure and monitoring when no actual disclosure artifact or approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
That the non-core or low-volume characterization resolves materiality for this segment.
